reviews.text: Horrible Update. The update is horrible. I’m so upset and disappointed because I feel my data isn’t there or it isn’t clear. Doesn’t make sense, and extremely confusing. Says my period is late when I already logged it. I can’t even see my history anymore. You click on it and the log is all blank unless you click on it and even then it doesn’t make sense. Bring back the old PLEASE!

Updates made things worse. This app used to be great but the new updates have made things worse, honestly. The calendar is off, the dates don’t align with the days and it makes logging periods confusing. All of the extra adds and articles aren’t needed and i think it makes the app look cluttered. Hopefully they fix the calendar issue soon because I have just decided to use a different tracker app untim further notice but I’ve logged so many notes/periods with this app.

Multithreading problems. Became absolutely unusable. Freezes and won’t update UI forever. Did you hire some noob developers who never heard of concurrency and threading? Please look into multi threading issues.

Deleting this app now. The last time I used this app was in Jan when I added my last cycle. I’ve used this app for years w/o issues. I used the free version because all I needed it for was to help me keep track of my cycle. I came back today to check and see how much longer I have since I’m not regular. I can sort of gauge a window of time for my next cycle. Anyway, I came back to having to answer so many questions. No “skip” allowed. And if I’m using the free version, you don’t need my age or any other info from me. Then it asks me how I want to “log in”. Never had that before either with the free version. So now, I have to start over with a different app. Some may see this as no big deal, and maybe it’s not. However, it wasn’t broke, I feel you should have left it alone. And you don’t need my info.

Confused and Frustrated. After switching to this new format, this app became not user friendly at all! Dates, even through 2022 and farther back, are not listed as the correct day of the week. Plus, now when adding or editing a note it’s attaching itself to the wrong date. On top of that, it doesn’t seem like notes that were added in the past have saved correctly.
I’ve been using the app for many years now, and I am one that will still go back and check/compare previous notes. But obviously that’s an issue if they’re not showing up or in the correct day. All in all it’s just been a very frustrating experience.
I don’t want to change apps because of the extensive history on this one, but it may have to come to that if things can’t be resolved. It would be a shame to have to transfer everything in my history, or lose years worth of data.
Update ruined it. Not user friendly anymore. Restrictive. Can’t update or edit things anymore. I’m deleting it.

Glitchy and slow. I have used this app for years, I will say within the last year or so the app has gotten glitchy and slow. I can’t understand why the app would not be working but it’s very frustrating.

Even with keeping up with newer phones and upgrades, I am surprised it still doesn’t work well. Also, it gives inaccurate information, which is not helpful at all if trying to conceive.
